name: Pro Spreadsheet
description: Embeddable Excel-style spreadsheet: virtualised grid for 10k+ rows, formula engine with ~50 functions and an incremental dependency graph, cross-sheet references, fill handle, TSV copy/paste with Excel, undo/redo, number formats, column resize, frozen panes and sheet tabs.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or initial workbook: sheets with sparse raw cells keyed "row:col", formats, column widths and frozen panes

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called after every edit, paste, fill, undo/redo, format or sheet change

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called when the selected range changes

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Disables editing, paste, fill and sheet management

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a skeleton instead of the grid

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO code used by the currency format (default USD)

usage: Formulas start with "=" and support A1, $A$1, ranges and Sheet!A1 references with SUM, AVERAGE, COUNTIF(S), SUMIF(S), VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, IF, IFERROR, ROUND, DATE, PMT and more (see FUNCTION_NAMES). Keyboard: arrows, Shift/Ctrl+arrows, Tab, Enter, F2, Delete, Ctrl+Z/Y, Ctrl+C/X/V, Ctrl+A.
